itinerary.title: Arrival and the city at walking pace
itinerary.source: You are met at Cairo International and transferred to the hotel.

itinerary.title: NMEC and the Giza plateau
itinerary.source: The second day carries the tour's two heaviest sites, and the sequencing is deliberate: the collection before the monuments, so that what you have read in the galleries is visible in stone on the plateau.

itinerary.title: Coptic Cairo, Ben Ezra Synagogue, Khan el-Khalili
itinerary.source: A third day is Cairo's other history — the one that predates the Arab conquest and runs back through Byzantium to the early Christian communities of the first and second centuries.
